**Problem**
What are you trying to do that the collection doesn't currently support? Concrete use case > abstract wish.

**Proposed solution**
If you have one. New variable, role entry point, playbook change, etc.

**Alternatives considered**
What workarounds did you try (`rke2_extra_config`, custom playbook on top of role entry points)?

**Scope**
- [ ] Role (`maksimrudakov.rke2.node`)
- [ ] Playbooks (deploy / upgrade / reconfig / rotate_certs)
- [ ] Docs / examples
- [ ] Other / not sure
